pure-announcement.rationale: Reference documentation for Tauri's updater plugin, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts cover agent skills, OSV and MCP topics; none covers signed application update delivery.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every behavior described is verifiable against the open-source plugin, its config schema and the linked API references.

durability.rationale: The mandatory-signature update model (pinned public key, unlosable private key) endures, but the note is pinned to v2 config keys — one of which it says will be removed in v3 — plus Rust version floors and permission identifiers.

actionability.rationale: The steps are entirely Tauri-product-specific — this config key, this CLI command, this permission set — with nothing that transfers to update systems generally.

atomicity.rationale: For all its reference detail it serves one statable idea: deliver in-app updates as signed artifacts verified against a pinned key, from either a static manifest or a 204/200 dynamic server.
